The studio's own words and rules
  ok    the tool, labeled Pro
  ok    email offered, only on a paid-up Studio or Scale plan
  ok    a paid-up-no-more Studio store is told why, not offered Pro
  ok    the sender's fields and their save, first, as the studio says them
  ok    the compose words, the draft, when, the check and the confirms, as the studio says them
  ok    sending for the owner or an Admin, writing drafts for an Editor too
  ok    no button starts or changes a plan while none is on sale, as the checkout and the switch refuse
  ok    the trial's emails only said while a trial can start

The answers, in both states
  ok    two questions
  ok    sending: both plans, paid up, the studio's label, who presses what, the studio's words in order
  ok    try before paying: not yet today; the shared answer on Studio or Scale later, not on a Store trial
  ok    one space between sentences, never two
  ok    no figure but the trial's days, no percent, no result promised

On the email page
  ok    first in the page's own Questions block
  ok    no question asked twice
  ok    no sentence of the answers said elsewhere on the page, or twice among them

16 checks, all passing.
